verdict.rationale: Mesh's own screening workflow can be driven through a documented API. You create and screen a customer synchronously or asynchronously, learn completion through a WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook, read the screening_result, and review or remediate cases via the API. A Postman collection and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema document these steps. This is AML screening rather than an identity-verification session, so captured media and cancel/redact steps have no evidence. missing for 10: verification-session create/status endpoints, retrieval of captured media (documents/selfies), cancel or redact endpoints, hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end lifecycle
